name: User expresses anger after benefits enrollment glitch
goal: Evaluate bot's ability to de-escalate when user is angry about a benefits portal error.
constraints: Bot must acknowledge frustration, apologize, and offer next steps.

phases.description: User reports being unable to enroll in health insurance due to a portal error.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the report and asks for error details.

phases.description: User expresses anger (e.g., 'This system is useless!').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot apologizes, acknowledges frustration, and offers to escalate or provide alternative solutions.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
